translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Mz nzmnc-xgle-krm Yawe kc tqmyalz-esz'ngr
Sa natubz mz nibrm.
X narpibzme mz Gct kc tqrninr kx, “Nim Gct rnge kc tqabrkitrx drtwrnge,
Mz nzapu-krme bange lrpalvc kx rlakitrx.”
Murde sa na-arlapxle nim mz nzatrkangr kx yc kapq,
X mz nzrpibqtingr.
Sa na-aclve-zpwxle nim,
Na-apule kio kc tqwxbulvzole neideng.
X sa na-angidatibzle natqdeng
Mz nzapu-krbzle bam temz ngr lomrm kc tqyrputrngr nipna.
Bzkq mwxlrq mz nrlckxbq x nrlckxngrlx,
Mz nzmwxlrti-krm drka', ncblo kxayo, x zyagox kxnabzngr.
Murde kxmule-esz' siu ngr leplz nzbz-aepztrpzng bam,
Mzli kc Gct na-ayrplapx-ngrde kxdrka'-ngrng,
X mcq mz mzpq nzbz-krdr,
A' trtxpnzngr nzatrkati-krdr nim.
Murde mz nzrpi-krbzme mz Yawe kx nide me rlakitrq,
X mz nzmnc-xgle-krm nide kc tqmyalz,
Trpnzngr doa x da kx na-atrkale nim,
X trpnzngr kz zyagox kx navztrpq ma nyzm.
Murde pipebz Yawe mz enjrl nedeng nztu-krbzlr mz nibrm,
X nzaclve-zpwx-krdr nim drlvekeng vzkiq.
Naglqlr nim mz mqdr,
Murde nanycm ma tqtcprtr mz rplz.
Mz nzrmcti-krm ningidoe kc bqnc, sa na-aovxioq nide.
Kxmule-esz' nide drka' kxmatq, a' sa narnzlvzoq nide.
Murde Yawe Gct rpile kx, “Sa na-arlapxx doa kx mrlztile ninge,
X sa na-aclvex nide mz nzmnc-xgle-krde ninge.
Mz nzkqle-krde ninge, sa na-ayzlubo natqde.
Kxmule-esz' da kx prtz, a' sa namnc-aepztrpo bade,
X sa nakatxpxx nide mz nzkxpu-krdeng,
X sa na-armyalzx nide.
X doa lc sa namcle nzarlapx-krnge nide,
X nakabo bade nzlungr kxboi kx na-abrtz-ngrde.”
